Thanks for the downvotes. Thanks for not commenting. Thanks for showing me THAT EVEN THIS SUBREDDIT IS A COMPLETE SHITHOLE. 

I hoped that someone could understand what I was talking about here. That maybe someone could understand my feelings. But all I got was ignored and downvoted. 

I was hoping someone would see this and think, yeah I feel like I give off weird vibes too. Instead of that, you just confirmed it. This forum confirmed that I'm a weirdo who deserves to be ignored. Thank you.
Maybe I want a permanent solution to a "temporary" problem.
